title: Voltane - Small cars. Big damages.
author: MacXou34
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'm making Voltane, a racing game with radio-controlled cars: tiny racers let loose across a suburban neighborhood, through a two-story house and around an arena full of ramps. And things break: cars lose parts, and anything lying around gets smashed to bits.

What's in so far:

\- 3 tracks: the Maplewood neighborhood, the House and the Arena.

\- 21 cars to unlock as you level up, each with its own handling (nitro even works mid-air, and one of the cars can glide).

\- Online with up to 8 players: quick match, ranked (with a seasonal leaderboard) or private lobbies with friends. Bots fill the grid when there aren't enough people.

\- Solo: races against bots (5 difficulty levels, from chill to genuinely hard), time trials with ghosts, and free driving.

\- Keyboard, gamepad or touch: it runs on PC and on phones with nothing to install (you can add it to your home screen like an app).

It's free with no ads. You need an account to play (email or Google, it only takes a moment): that's what keeps your progress and your garage. No pay-to-win: cars and bolts are earned by playing, and the shop only sells supporter packs with cosmetics.

It's still an early beta, so there will be bugs and plenty left to tune. What would help me most is your feedback on:

\- the handling (I want it loose and slidey like a real RC car, not glued to the road);

\- performance on your PCs and phones;

\- what's missing, or what bugs you.

Play: https://playvoltane.com

Discord: https://discord.gg/JXg6Xr97aH

Thanks for reading, I'll be around to answer comments!

comments.author: shimroot
comments.body:
Pretty nice, I take it Re-Volt was the inspiration?

Feedback:

* on my M5 Macbook Air it runs quite hot and low-ish fps: 30-45; resolution seems quite low as well even tho graphics settings on Auto were saying High.
* car feel is nice-ish; I like it overall, but it seems a bit too sensitive at times. Maybe it's because the low fps and/or some lag that makes it less responsive

replies.author: MacXou34
replies.body:
Hello Shim and thank you for your feedback, I loved Re-volt & Flatout back in the days, Voltane is a mix of both 😁

We are still optimising the game and will have a look at this, meanwhile, you can try to play with the settings or use a lower preset (low/mid) and see if the experience feels smoother.

Thanks again for your feedback !
